summary: @ornikar/babel-preset-kitt-universal preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares itself a Babel preset but its package.json preinstall hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ (or uses a system `bun`), chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync to run the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a single-line ~727KB obfuscator.io-style payload (string-array + rotator function WV8StW, mangled identifiers) whose behavior cannot be determined without runtime deobfuscation. setup.mjs itself is obfuscated with hex-mangled identifiers and per-function property-lookup indirection wrapping ordinary Node stdlib calls (https.get, execFileSync, fs.chmodSync). A Babel preset has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time, ship a 727KB opaque bundled blob, or obfuscate its own install script. The composite shape — install-time fetch of a runtime + execution of a bundled obfuscated payload + obfuscated preinstall wrapper — fires automatically on `npm install`, yielding arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
